train.claim: Port Selwyn is the capital of Tamarind Cay.
The national currency is the cay dollar.
Tamarind Cay has a national railway network.
The Lantern Festival lasts three nights.
Cayan children start school at age five.
Dried tamarind pulp is the main export.
The Assembly is elected every six years.

test.claim: The Selwyn Causeway connects Greater Cay to Pell.
Visitors ride the inter-island ferries for free.
The crimson tern nests on several different islands.
The dry season runs from January to March.
The island nation has a national football team.
Most residents live outside Port Selwyn.
The Bank of Tamarind sets the interest rate at 4 percent.
